title: Asteria by TxPipe: A bot challenge to showcase the capabilities of the UTxO model

ms.promise:
- a set of Aiken on-chain validators to enforce the rules of the challenge
- documentation describing the rules of the challenge
- example transactions executed on preprod demonstrating different interactions
ms.criteria:
- a technical reviewer / developer is able to understand the rules of the challenge
- feasibility of the onchain logic has been confirmed by executing transaction in a testnet
ms.report:
We are pleased to announce the successful completion of Milestone #1 for the Asteria Catalyst project. 
Milestone goals and proofs of completion
Documentation describing the rules of the challenge
We defined the rules of the Asteria challenge. The document contains a comprehensive description of game overview, components and rules to play. 
https://github.com/txpipe/asteria/blob/main/rules.md
A set of Aiken on-chain validators to enforce the rules of the challenge
Before implementing the source code of the game, we wrote a document describing the technical design. It contains a specification of every utxo involved, transaction diagrams and description of every check for each validator.
https://github.com/txpipe/asteria/blob/main/onchain/docs/mvp-design/design.md
Then we implemented the onchain Aiken code that can be found here:
https://github.com/txpipe/asteria/tree/main/onchain/src
Example transactions executed on preprod demonstrating different interactions
- Create Asteria transaction:
https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/9a284655d63d64a1d179755442625ab6eafda098e3ce4175ab499b030f9102f2
- Create Pellet transaction:
https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/f86cd01d1372e4818ca017e9aa046597d3530e6272e029200eff4c0e9375772c
- Create Ship transaction:
https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/c40015a8acfd131b3bdd9cd19e146aca14f8bcd5426495e253b3b19ae0bb5a55
- Move Ship transaction:
https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/ceea9d447cc6395285a2c13ed271023bf02c795a21cacff8e4028c3577674594
Video: https://youtu.be/egaK8WRNSAE?feature=shared
Next Steps
We have already accomplished the goals of milestone 1 designing and implementing the onchain code, also submitting several transactions to preprod. Next step consists on developing algorithms for creating random grids of the game, implementing them, submitting a concrete map to preprod and documentation explaining how to explore it.
We are confident that we’ll be able to accomplish the goals in time.

ms.report:
- a public website serving as entry-point to the challenge 
The public-facing website, accessible at asteria.txpipe.io, serves as the main entry-point for the Asteria challenge. It includes a landing page that presents an overview of the game, describing objectives and unique elements of Asteria’s gameplay experience.
- a public map visualizer showing status of the game
A map visualizer, available at asteria.txpipe.io/map, tracks and displays the current status of the challenge. This component visualizes the positions of all active participants (ships and pilots), and locations of in-game elements, such as fuel pellets and reward zones.
- end-user documentation with instructions on how to participate in the challenge
Detailed user documentation is provided at asteria.txpipe.io/how-to-play, which includes; step-by-step instructions on how to join and engage with the challenge, and a glossary of terms to clarify game-specific language and mechanics.

Current game data corresponds to a test challenge we did earlier this year in Cardano Buidler Fest with participants from the event.
